sources.title: Agentastic overview
sources.locator: Native macOS app; supported agents; isolation; review
sources.finding: Describes SwiftUI and AppKit UI, parallel coding-agent CLIs, custom terminal tools, subscriptions, Git worktrees and Docker or Apple containers.

sources.title: Agentastic release notes
sources.finding: Documents Spaces task launching, manager issue pages, automatic continuation, token and estimated-cost display, artifact gallery, chat restoration and fixes.

sources.title: Manager Agents
sources.locator: Creating; issues; execution; remote hosts; Superfans
sources.finding: Product-owned managers start and steer workers with dev, keep issues and wiki history, schedule runs and validate reports. Local managers require an open app; remote managers run on the host. No manager token or spend caps.

sources.title: System dev CLI
sources.finding: Documents Unix-socket JSON-RPC CLI for workspaces, worktrees, launch, status, tail, messages, manager objectives, artifacts and shared-space operations.

sources.title: Cloud agents
sources.locator: Providers; credentials; lifecycle and cost controls
sources.finding: User supplies provider accounts and credentials; Agentastic provisions cloud sandboxes/VMs. Lifetimes and disconnect behavior vary by provider; persistent Hetzner/DigitalOcean VMs keep billing when powered off.

sources.title: Remote machines
sources.finding: SSH workers and terminals persist after Mac disconnect; user can manage remote repos, worktrees, agents and tunnels. Cross-host agent access is configurable.

sources.title: Issue tracking
sources.locator: Overview; linking; what the agent receives
sources.finding: Linear and Sentry issues can be linked into prompts and worktrees; tracker plugins expose MCP search, read, comment and update.

sources.title: Spaces
sources.finding: Project overview shows attention, review-ready work, CI and 30-day activity history; board filters and labels organize tasks.

sources.title: Artifacts
sources.finding: Agents publish files; versions and searchable gallery persist, with comments and remote offline delivery.

sources.title: Code review
sources.locator: Supported agents; using review; multi-agent reviews
sources.finding: Optional review invokes chosen reviewer CLIs in separate terminal tabs with captured diff and commit history; custom review commands are supported.

sources.title: iPhone Companion
sources.finding: Public TestFlight iPhone client pairs with a Mac using direct or relayed encrypted connections and supports agent monitoring and approvals.

sources.title: License
sources.finding: Agentastic.dev is proprietary and its source is not published. Open-source dependencies retain their own licenses.
